content.body: The MAS.38 was a technically advanced and accurate weapon with novel features such as a recoil mechanism which actually tracked through a tube bored into the stock (thus the oddly bent look to the weapon). But its quality couldn't compensate for the sub-par 7.65 mm pistol round it fired, which gave it a reputation for ineffectiveness on the battlefield.
content.brief: WEAPON: MAS mle 38 Submachine Gun AMMO: Cartouche de 7.65 mm longue MAGAZINE: 32 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 350 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 600 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Pistolet Automatique mle 1935A 7.65 mm Grenade OF (HE) (4) Grenade Fumigène (Smoke Grenades) (4) Combat Knife Satchel Charge (1) Ammo Resupply Pack (1)
content.title: Airborne Submachine Gunner
